introduction.lead: HEJŐTRADE Kft. is a Hungarian-owned company established in 1997, which has continuously expanded its professional competencies over the decades.
introduction.paragraph1: HEJŐTRADE Kft. was established in Miskolc in 1997 with the aim of providing mining and energy-related services to its clients.
introduction.paragraph2: The company's founder, Árpád Bánhegyi, a Golden Degree civil engineer and former CEO of the Borsod County State Construction Company, established a professional foundation based on engineering expertise and practical experience.
introduction.paragraph3: Over the decades, our range of activities has expanded significantly, from mining design and engineering consulting through energy projects and general contracting to steel structure manufacturing and technological prefabrication.
introduction.quote: Reliable performance and long-term professional partnerships are among the most important foundations of our operation.

history.title: More than two decades of experience
history.description: Continuous development, new areas of expertise and long-term partnerships have shaped HEJŐTRADE over the years.

about.companyText: HEJŐTRADE Kft. has several decades of professional experience in mining, energy, construction, technological and engineering services. Our aim is to provide reliable, high-quality and sustainable solutions for our partners.

hero.title: Mining design and geothermal expertise
hero.description: Design, permitting and technical support for stone and gravel mines, extraction sites, mining-right matters and geothermal projects.

overview.lead: Since its establishment, our company has participated in the preparation, design and permitting of mining and extraction-site projects.
overview.paragraph1: Within the areas formerly administered by the Miskolc and Szolnok mining authorities, we have gained experience in the design and permitting of stone and gravel mines and material extraction sites. Our activities also include mineral resource assessment and related data services.
overview.paragraph2: In addition to conventional mining assignments, our services cover geological research, geothermal project planning and coordination, as well as professional support for the necessary legal and land-registry procedures.
overview.highlight: Our integrated approach combines engineering, geological and legal expertise within the same project framework.

hero.title: Industrial power supply from design to implementation
hero.description: Substations, underground cables, busbar systems, temporary and industrial power supply, and energy project management for industrial environments.

overview.lead: In our energy projects, design, permitting, construction and coordination tasks are handled as connected project phases.
overview.paragraph1: Our company has undertaken the installation and permitting of substations, laying and termination of underground cables, construction of busbar systems and implementation of power supply solutions for industrial sites.
overview.paragraph2: Alongside technical implementation, we have also participated in developing energy solutions for industrial consumers, planning and permitting grid connections, and managing ESCO-financed projects.
overview.highlight: Since 2022, we have participated in industrial energy-supply and ESCO development projects as a contracted partner of MVM companies.

hero.description: Fabrication, prefabrication, welding and pipe-installation capabilities for custom industrial and structural-steel assignments.

overview.lead: Over the years, the company expanded its activities with steel-structure and mechanical fabrication as well as technological prefabrication.
overview.paragraph1: Our technological construction work ranges from steel fabrication and preparation through on-site assembly, TIG welding and isometric pipe installation to integrated industrial implementation.
overview.paragraph2: The documented references include industrial manufacturing and technological projects as well as a proprietary steel-structure development, reflecting both fabrication and implementation expertise.
overview.highlight: The first phase of the steel grandstand at the Tóstrand City Stadium in Salgótarján is a fabrication and general-construction reference connected to an in-house development.
